nodes.description: Owner address declared in BotProtected and set to tx.origin in the SHFL constructor; used as the sole authorization principal for privileged functions.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract that is invoked with low-level .call from the checkBots modifier and from list().
Uniswap pair address derived in the constructor and forwarded into the bot-protection calldata.
Public token balance mapping written with unchecked += and -= arithmetic in transferFrom and list().
Public allowance mapping; constructor grants type(uint).max approvals to itself, the router and tx.origin.
Public total supply of 100000000000000000000000000 SHFL used to compute privileged allocations in list().
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router address that receives the addLiquidityETH external call with msg.value.
Hard-coded WETH address passed to pairForUniswap for pair address derivation.
Private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
BotProtected constructor that assigns stopTheBots from the _botProtection argument.
Modifier that performs an unchecked low-level stopTheBots.call with a raw selector before the guarded body runs.
ERC20 transfer forwarding msg.sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom using SafeMath allowance subtraction and _transfer.
ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Internal balance mutation routine with zero-address checks.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Overflow-checked addition helper.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper.
SHFL constructor assigning owner = tx.origin, deriving uniPair and granting unlimited allowances.
Payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable, bot-protected transferFrom performing manual allowance/balance accounting with unchecked arithmetic.
Payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without a zero-value reset.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address a with calldata b.
CREATE2-style pair address derivation from two sorted token addresses.
Owner-only function that overrides balances, adds liquidity via the Uniswap router, calls stopTheBots and distributes balances in a loop.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance, owner checks and balance accounting.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to compute the addLiquidityETH deadline in list().
Originating EOA used to set the owner state variable and to grant unlimited allowance in the constructor.
a.delegatecall(b) in SHFL.delegate executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in the contract context.
stopTheBots.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141,...)) low-level external call inside the checkBots modifier with no interface or gas restriction.
External call routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) forwarding ETH to a hard-coded router with deadline block.timestamp + 600.
stopTheBots.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xd5eaf4c3,_tooWho)) low-level external call made inside the list() distribution flow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in SHFL.transferFrom (Solidity 0.7 wraps around).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked arithmetic in SHFL.transferFrom.
Constructor argument supplying the external bot-protection contract address.
Sender address forwarded into the bot-protection low-level call.
Recipient address forwarded into the bot-protection low-level call.
Transfer amount forwarded into the bot-protection low-level call.
Amount assigned to the contract balance and used as the liquidity token amount in list().
Array of recipient addresses used both in the stopTheBots calldata and the distribution loop.
Array of amounts assigned to the recipients in the distribution loop.
Loop counter iterating over _tooWho/_amounts in list().
Caller-supplied target address of the delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
Caller-supplied calldata passed to the delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
Spender whose allowance is overwritten in SHFL.approve.
Recipient of SHFL.transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount transferred by SHFL.transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the allowance and balance authority used by SHFL.transferFrom when it differs from _from.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by SHFL.approve.
SHFL.delegate authorizes execution solely on the comparison msg.sender == owner.
SHFL.list authorizes minting, liquidity provision and balance overwrites on msg.sender == owner.
tx.origin is read inside the SHFL constructor to establish the owner authorization principal.
tx.origin is stored into the owner state variable, making all privileged checks tx.origin-derived.
The tx.origin-derived owner gates the arbitrary delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
The tx.origin-derived owner gates liquidity addition and balance distribution in SHFL.list.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, a miner-influenceable timestamp dependency.
The checkBots modifier executes an unconstrained external low-level call before the guarded function body mutates state.
SHFL.transferFrom is guarded by checkBots, so an untrusted external call precedes the balance/allowance updates.
SHFL.delegate hands control to an attacker-influenced address through delegatecall.
SHFL.list performs an external addLiquidityETH call with msg.value while balances are being rewritten.
SHFL.list performs a second unchecked low-level external call to stopTheBots after adding liquidity.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction under Solidity 0.7.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked arithmetic on the public balance mapping.
addLiquidityETH can trigger token/pair callbacks that reenter SHFL before list() finishes updating balances.
The stopTheBots low-level call can reenter transferFrom before the guarded balance updates complete.
The stopTheBots call inside list() can reenter the contract before the distribution loop finalizes state.
SHFL.transfer forwards msg.sender, _to and _value into SHFL.transferFrom.
The owner state variable is the sole gate for the arbitrary delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
The owner state variable is the sole gate for SHFL.list.
stopTheBots is the target address of the low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
stopTheBots is the target address of the low-level call inside list().
routerForUniswap is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
uniPair is embedded into the bot-protection calldata built by checkBots.
wrappedEther is used together with the token address in pairForUniswap.
balanceOf is both read for the sufficiency check and mutated in SHFL.transferFrom.
allowance is read and decremented in SHFL.transferFrom without SafeMath.
balanceOf entries are arbitrarily overwritten inside list() for the contract and the recipients.
totalSupply is used to compute the owner allocation totalSupply * 6 / 100 in list().
_botProtection is assigned to the stopTheBots state variable in the BotProtected constructor.
_from is encoded into the raw bot-protection call inside checkBots.
_to is encoded into the raw bot-protection call inside checkBots.
_value is encoded into the raw bot-protection call inside checkBots.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity token amount in list().
_tooWho supplies both the stopTheBots calldata and the distribution loop recipients.
_amounts supplies the balance values written in the list() distribution loop.
Loop counter i indexes _tooWho and _amounts during balance distribution.
a is the call target of the delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
b is the calldata passed to the delegatecall in SHFL.delegate.
_spender is the allowance key written by SHFL.approve.
_to is forwarded from SHFL.transfer into transferFrom.
_value is forwarded from SHFL.transfer into transferFrom.
